concepts.gloss_en: the counsel of THE tzaddikim (definite — the true/righteous ones as a defined group whose intellect-drops one receives)
counsel of tzaddikim (indefinite — righteous ones generally, no defined referent)

notes: Both forms appear in the same Torah (lm1:7) and may well denote the same referent there, but they differ precisely by the definite article on a plural construct head (הצדיקים vs צדיקים). Per the protocol, this article difference is not silently mergeable and both definite/indefinite readings are plausible in these usages — kept separate and flagged archetype-question for human decision. Under-merge preferred.
